## How to Locate Text Labels on the Front End of a Website


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055818

First, access the website from the admin backend in order to display the Admin Bar .

Once the Admin Bar is active, click on the " Show Text Labels " icon. All the available Text Labels on that specific page, will be highlighted:

To look for the Text Label, scroll through the page, the text label will have a yellow background. By clicking on the text label the system will redirect to the Text Labels section with a search completed of the text label that was selected:

Or use the Text Label Search that can be found in the bottom right corner of the screen:

Edit the Text directly through the Text Label Search.

Important Note: T here are some areas the text labels cannot be highlighted by the tool, like if the text label is the placeholder attribute of a field, a <select><option>, or not initially displayed on the page.  However, using the on-page text label editor, the label can be found.

Additional Information:

Settings » Text Labels
